biography.plain_text: Gene Reed Jr. was an American car dealer who built a network of franchises from South Carolina. After a decade at Chrysler, he used its employee loan programme to buy a Dodge dealership in Spartanburg. He repaid the loan within seventeen months and expanded into Charleston and other American markets.

long_biography.plain_text:
Gene Reed's familiar presence in Lowcountry television advertising acquired a different setting when he gave five million dollars to children's cardiac care. The donation supported the heart programme at the Medical University of South Carolina's new Shawn Jenkins Children's Hospital. Its work included transplants, advanced heart failure treatment and psychological support for patients and families.

He had supported the children's hospital for more than two decades before that gift. Patients coming from outside Charleston also needed somewhere to stay during treatment. He financed the Gene Reed Hope Lodge to provide free accommodation for those receiving cancer care.
